text: The Priestess calls upon Myrmidia to bless her and her allies' weapons.
Guidance by Myrmidia and Her Templars inspire feats of bravery in the face of the most terrifying foes.
Skilled warriors, Priests and Templars of Myrmidia know how to strike fast and accurately.
By the commands of a master tactician, the frontline is a solid anvil.
When the company's money chest is, so to speak, a capital at risk, everyone is driven to 'selfless' acts of bravery to protect it from the wrong hands.
Oi, get yer hands offa ma pay! may not be a warcry for the history books, yet many attackers may be repelled when the Paymaster is down and the chest is unprotected.
Once the Paymaster's chest is lost and reasonably out of reach, there is little point for mercenaries to hang around the battlefield after the immediate opponents have been dispatched.
With unfailing accuracy, the Inquisitor declares his target a sinner and heretic beyond repentance.
Get them! Ten per cent bonus for every confirmed kill! Halved pay if they touch me!
Nothing like "Betrayal Incentives" to weaken the enemy's resolve.
Fine! Double pay! Now go out there and take that position!
The commander personally leads the ambush against the enemy, noiselessly following the best path.
The enemy might expect the old "What is that?!" trick, but there are other ways to distract them.
This is for the AI. Nothing to see here. Move along, sir. Also completely obsolete, will remove at some point.
Borgio is notoriously one for defying death in multiple occasions, which fed to his fame.
Troops easily followed Borgio not only because of his victory streaks, but also because he seemingly cared for the well-being of his troops.
Together with his imposing appearance - and the approaching of a huge mace - Borgio's grotesque mask-helm may scare the opponent.
A cannonball - the very same that failed to kill Borgio - turned into a talisman and weapon. Unsubtle but very powerful.
An imposing plate forged from melted-down statues from the marshes. Very thick and quite probably magical.
Drawing upon Ulgu and Ushoran's teachings, Gashnag covers himself and his allies in a protective deception.
Gashnag is known for single-handedly defeating marauding parties. In order to protect his subjects, he can unleash the strength of his bloodline upon the aggressors.
One of Ushoran's own artefacts, this polestaff supposedly allowed the original Strigoi patriarch to hold out the Lahmians' aggression for so long.
Most men will find it difficult to waver under the glare of the most beautiful woman in the Old World.
Discreetly poisoning the enemy commanders the night before battle is... well, just another continuation of diplomacy, like war itself.
Another secret recipe of Lucrezzia's, this concoction will greatly improve the imbiber's strength and resilience. Maybe, just maybe, also poison them. A bit.
The Lady of Pavona is famous, among other things, for kissing the weapon of today's champion before his duel or battle. Of course, her lipstick is terribly poisonous.
Lucrezzia always wears, somewhere on her person, a dagger coated with another of her brews. Can't blame someone for being prepared for a midnight stab.
A solid pikeline attacked on the front is virtually unassailable, and it quickly tranforms in a spiky caterpillar of death.
Catrazza is an excellent duelist and he wouldn't have known the hidden properties of his ring without being almost defeated by a Warboss.
This ring bears an eerie and intriguing aura over it. Inquisitors never managed to get it off Lupio for investigation.
Radiant Pegasi are a living siphon of light and magic. When threatened, they can discharge those shimmering forces against aggressors.
A cloak made of Lustrian gold, with uncertain magic properties. Its known feature is to give Lupio immense satisfaction.
This powerful runic axe is cumbersome but surprisingly agile.
An ancient elven blade, relic of a time when Tilea was an Asur colony. Its wielder's attacks leave a glowing and elegant trail of light and molten armour.

Formerly a magic and fluttering arabyan turban, this souvenir bears energetic enchantments. The cadre of Myrmidian priests who prodded it for a week have testified that the scarf won't strangle Gausser of its own initiative anytime soon, which is oddly specific.
A high-power spyglass and Colombo's skills make finding stealthy enemies that much easier.
A reward from the Slann, this amulet in the shape of Sotek's tongue feels oddly alive and protected the wearer more times than he recalls.
About as potent as orange juice to the Lizardmen, this precious lustrian wine is strong indeed for a human!
Used by someone to write an otherwise uninteresting map, this scroll bears potent enchantments of Nehekharan protective magic. However, it tends to crumble a bit with each use.
Cadavo seems to leave any catastrophe unscathed, by luck, either of the many amulets he carries, or just a quirk of destiny.
An amulet made of a weird alloy, capable of neutralizing poisons and many of the magical properties for weapons that would injure the bearer.
Whatever the enemy, Cadavo is unsubtle in his subtlety and will exploit any possibly trick to vex the enemy. His troops are veteran harriers and have learned from the best.
I love the face dem Bretonnians do when you slash their precious horses' hocks from under them. I mean, you can't see because of the buckets, but I bet it's hilarious.
These bastions aren't just very pretty.
In the end, routing foes are just different cattle to steal.
A cry of "Lo' and behold, the rising sun in the east!" bears more meaning while battling undead in the dusk.
One way or another we're going out with a bang, lads!
Let the enemy gaze upon the divine form of a woman scorned.
Break thine spears on thine enemy with the wrath of Sister Fury!

The Nehekharans placed a curse of the gods of thieves upon Eustaquio, one that has particular meaning against graverobbers. Nevertheless, he thinks his current state of unlife and golden skeleton are some sort of boon, and will not be convinced otherwise.
The spear hums with a dull vibration and finally rings like a deathly bell. Whatever divine or magic power resides within, it attemps to restore balance of life and death.
There is an undeniable grace in the art of swordsmanship.
The Duellist's challenge is undeniable and verbose.
You are so ugly that even your sword runs away from you!
Fear the duellist who won't give in, but woe unto his foe if the diestro knows victory is in his expensive pocket!
I tell ya, the necromancer was all nyeeeh!", and then he was "nyeeh?". Then the boss took 'is head orf, just like that."
Diverting power from artillery to propulsion, the vehicle can enjoy a sudden burst of mobility while the crew tries their best not to release their breakfasts.
The Black Watch may lack the technique or the toughness of some veterans accompanying them, but there is untapped savagery in certain minds.
You think you're tough? And what do you do when Giants come a-knocking? That's right, you call for the shooters. We help each other on the field, because that's all there is. Keep that in mind.
Incessant drilling and unconventional tactics can turn a bloody melee for the walls into... a more successful bloody melee.
Where is the Prince, you ask? Just follow the laughter and the thickest melee.
This ancient shield might predate the city of Luccini, and still embodies the power of the sun.
This blade is believed to be the actual sword used by his remote ancestor, Lucan, one of the twin divine founders of Luccini.
Lorenzo is obsessive in practicing one of his training pursuits, and he will always at least do a hearty warm-up before battle.
If there is one glorious tradition the kossar guard will keep up, it's vodka.
You know, I'm something of a sorceress myself.
Lucrezzia is somewhat rumoured to be a Lahmian vampire, though that merely suggests lack of imagination over what one clever woman can do.
The Golden Lion unleashes wild Chamon at his foes, watching with contempt as they transmute into Unliving golden statues.
The Golden Lion focuses the winds around itself and his allies, turning fur and scale in resplendent and dazzling armour.
That's it. They squealed their last oink.
Someone, somewhere in that army, is doubting the valour of the duellists or their compatriots'.
These irregulars will hardly ever attack a foe from the front, but they can punch up something wicked on their own terms.
